NONE: › used to form adjectives; belonging or relating to a particular type of scientific study
› used to form nouns; an expert in a particular area of scientific study
（名詞的後綴，指某一科研領域的學者專家）
› a subject that is studied at school, college, or university and is thought to need a large amount of special knowledge
（在學校、學院或大學學習研究的科目，需要相當多的專業知識的）學科
› the scientific study of a particular subject

example: "What's his new girlfriend studying?" "Oh, some ology or other. Pharmacology, I think."
「他的新女友在唸甚麼？」「一門專業學科吧，我想大概是藥理學。」
